import: In Resolve use File > Import > Timeline and pick the .fcpxml.

For a non-16:9 or custom timeline size (a 9:16 short), tick 'Use sizing information' and 'Automatically set project settings': the scripted import ignores the FCPXML format size, so a 9:16 short came in at 1920x1080.
'Import source clips' can be left on in the dialog (the scripted import cancels with it on; import the media first there).
